The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces tighten the encirclement
around the AFU formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and
expand the external control zone.
📍
Fights are underway in the encirclement for the liberation
of Varvarovka, Nikolayevka, Lobanovka, and Reznikovo in Kharkov region. The destruction of the enemy's encircled formations continues close to Rublenoye, Nefedovka, Kupino, and Chernoye in Kharkov region.
▪️
The AFU losses in the encirclement ring amounted to more then 35 troops during the day. A UAV command post was destroyed.
📍
During the expansion of the external control zone, combat operations are underway
near Prikolotnoye and Annopolye (Kharkov region). Strikes are delivered at the enemy in Berezhnoye, Podsredneye, Kurgannoye, and Maly Burluk (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, in Kharkov region,
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU were hit close to Sosnovka, Kupino, Pioner, Odnorobovka, and Podsredneye in Kharkov region.
🔥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered
at formations of one AFU airmobile brigade and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine near Kiyanitsa, Vakalovshchina, and Luzhki (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 235 troops, an armoured personnel carrier, three armoured fighting vehicles, 22 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one radar station in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Maleyevka, Studenok (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, Karpovka, Krestishche, and Volchiy Yar (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 225 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, one mountain assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades close to Slavyansk, Semenovka, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, Krasny Molochar, Kramatorsk, and Vysokoivanovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 180 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns.
👉

Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army
advanced in the northern and central parts of the city.
Marine units completed mopping-up of residential building in the eastern areas of the city and continued offensive in its northern part.
📊
Over the past 24 hours, 53 buildings have been liberated, up to 20 Ukrainian servicemen have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, more than 435 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibilitys.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
Russian troops inflicted damage on manpower and hardware of three air assault brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade have been hit close to Prosyanaya, Katerinovka, Orestopol, Shevchenko, Ivanovka, Dibrova (Dnepropetrovsk region), Vasinovka, Dubovy Gay, Obshcheye and Nikolskoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 290 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, and five motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group of Forces' units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU have been hit near Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, Kamyshevakha, Dimitrov, and Zapasnoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 30 troops, 18 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.

item.content:encoded:

❗️
The Russian Defence Ministry has noted a statement by V. Zelenskiy that the Kiev regime will intensify strikes against Russian oil refineries in response to attacks on Ukraine's defence industry facilities in Kiev, where UAVs and missiles are produced for attacks on Russia, as well as on infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU.
In response to these threats, the Russian Defence Ministry recalls that the massive strikes are launched against Kiev and other Ukrainian regions specifically in retaliation for the actions of the Kiev regime's leader.
This refers to V. Zelenskiy’s attempts to disrupt the voting in the elections to the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation by launching terrorist strikes against civilian targets on the territory of Russia. The attacks were launched by targeting missile weapons and UAVs against district electoral commissions, which resulted in the death of six civilians.
This refers to attempts to organise a mass attack using more than 1,600 Ukrainian strike UAVs on 19–20 September against civilian targets in Moscow.
It regards to attempted terrorist strikes involving strike UAVs aimed at disrupting the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum in June 2026.
Finally, last night, the Kiev regime inflicted a deliberate terrorist attack on residential quarters of Belgorod, where there are no military facilities.
As a result of this strike, there are casualties and fatalities among civilians, and damage has been caused to apartment buildings, private homes, and personal vehicles.
Following today’s statement by Zelenskiy, strikes by the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation against military and defence industry facilities, as well as their related infrastructure in Kiev and other regions of Ukraine, will be intensified.
The population of Ukraine has only the leader of the Kiev regime to blame for this.
It is Zelenskiy who bears full personal and political responsibility for this.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔹 Supreme Commander-in-Chief Vladimir Putin congratulated the personnel and veterans of the Space Forces.
item.description: Supreme Commander-in-Chief Vladimir Putin congratulated the personnel and veterans of the Space Forces. The message reads, in part: 'Thanks to the dedicated work and talent of several generations of outstanding designers, scientists, engineers, test specialists and military experts, our country has acquired a reliable space-based missile defence shield: an effective instrument for maintaining global strategic parity. Unique technologies have been developed, and a powerful scientific and industrial foundation has been established. Today, the personnel and civilian staff of the Space Forces are carrying out critical tasks to ensure Russia’s security. They are doing extensive work to maintain communication and navigation systems and are promptly providing the Armed Forces and units participating in the special military operation with essential data. It is important to continue expanding the capabilities of our orbital satellite constellation and ground-based infrastructure, developing advanced technologies for cutting-edge weapons and equipment, and conducting promising studies. I am confident that you will continue to serve the Fatherland with honour, make a significant contribution to strengthening the combat capability of the Army and Navy, and help advance the national space programme.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
